protocol.selection: Configuration and ensemble member by development (10% of training conversations, has_prev positions) mean of best mean-skipped-blocks at precision 0.99 and 0.995.
protocol.thresholds: Policy parameter chosen on calibration split; reported on heldout; swapped direction also reported. heldout_frontier is the heldout-optimal parameter, for ranking only.
protocol.evaluation_subset: has_prev = window slots 1..7 (previous decode position captured) for all models; all_positions additionally for single-token models.
protocol.label: Native cached one-step counterfactual argmax agreement at each width, teacher-forced dataset continuation.
